label: become, became, becoming
title: youninaru
meaning: indicates a change which has taken place or will take place indicates a change which has taken place or will take place
meaning_example: I came to have an interest in Japan after I went to Japan

examples.japanese: I came to have an interest in Japan after I went to Japan
examples.body_text:
I came to have an interest in Japan after I went to Japan  

		日本へ行ってから、日本に興味(きょうみ)を持つようになりました。
examples.body_html:
I came to have an interest in Japan after I went to Japan  
日本へ行ってから、日本に興味(きょうみ)を持つようになりました。

examples.japanese: Unless you study kanji, you won’t become able to read Japanese newspapers.
examples.body_text:
Unless you study kanji, you won’t become able to read Japanese newspapers.  

		漢字を勉強しなければ、日本語の新聞(しんぶん)が読めるようにはなりません。
examples.body_html:
Unless you study kanji, you won’t become able to read Japanese newspapers.  
漢字を勉強しなければ、日本語の新聞(しんぶん)が読めるようにはなりません。
